services.name: Trial lesson
services.story: The main story: Noah's $20 trial lesson in Grace's Preschool 1, Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am, paid in full when booking. A single lesson ($28), a private lesson ($65) and each month of a monthly session ($112 for 4 weekly lessons, billed on the 1st with a text the day before) are paid this way too. A late cancel or a no-show: the price may be kept, only with Sam's OK. A missed monthly lesson gets a make-up with notice. Thunder or a pool closure: a free make-up or a refund.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Marcus and Leo (swim instructors who teach at families' pools)
B.customer: Alex M. (a parent, for their 6-year-old, Sofia) · other customers

services.name: Private lesson at your pool
services.story: The main story: Sofia's $75 private lesson at the family's pool with Marcus, Thu Oct 22 at 4:30pm, paid in full when booking. A $150 group lesson at a host pool and a pool party lifeguard ($120) are paid this way too. Late or nobody at the pool: the $75 may be kept, only with Sam's OK. Thunder or an unsafe pool: a free make-up or a refund.

services_shape: class: a spot in a set 30-minute group lesson by age and level, with a set number of swimmers per instructor, 1 trial spot per lesson and a waitlist; each swimmer is checked in on their own. A private lesson books one instructor, at the school's pool or the family's own pool. A lesson at a host pool (a community center, an apartment pool) books an instructor's time, with the host's OK
questions_before_times: who is swimming: the parent's own child, or the adult themselves
for a child: the age (it sets the lesson group)
comfort in water: puts their face in? floats? swims a few strokes alone? (it sets the level)
for a private lesson: at the school's pool or the family's own pool, and the goal
for a lesson at home: is the pool fenced, with a gate that latches?
safety_stop: a child who was in the water and is now coughing hard, struggling to breathe or very sleepy; someone hurt or unwell right now
first_steps: The pick-up list and the photo yes or no
license: from the state form: teaching swimming usually needs no state license; a pool used for lessons may need a health permit and inspections where the state's or county's rules require it (a switch); some places register a swim school or set rules for selling lessons ahead
staff_skills: group lessons by level, Parent and Tot, private lessons, adult beginners, swimmers with extra needs, lifeguarding
messages_never: a child's last name, age, health notes (like ear tubes or seizures), skills note, pick-up list or photos never go in a text; texts to the parent may use the child's first name only; texts to Sam or the staff carry no child details at all: they name the parent and the lesson, and link to the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
